answer_1.quote: LongBench measures various abilities of the testee given long input contexts. Specifically, we tested models on four related tasks in Long-Bench: Chinese Multi-doc QA, Synthetic tasks, summarization and single-doc QA.

answer_2.quote: our model has a Rouge-L of 44.6% in the Multi-doc QA task

answer_4.quote: A side-by-side (SBS) comparison was performed by 3 human annotators to check the general ability of our model.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to choose a better answer among two given answers unless the answers are both bad or the same
